quests.title: Retrieve a Muscle Drink
quests.walkthrough: Go to Paulownia Mall, enter the pharmacy, purchase a Muscle Drink for 1,000 Yen, and deliver it to Elizabeth in the Velvet Room.

quests.title: Retrieve a Juzumaru
quests.walkthrough: Explore the Arqa block of Tartarus (floors 36 to 41). You can find it inside rare/gold chests. Make sure you use a Twilight Fragment to open it.

quests.title: Retrieve a Wild Duck Burger
quests.walkthrough: Visit the Wild Duck Burger restaurant in the Iwatodai Strip Mall during the day or night, buy the burger, and return to Elizabeth.

quests.title: Retrieve a Jack Frost Doll
quests.walkthrough: Go to the Crane Game outside Game Panic in Paulownia Mall. Play the game (active on Fridays/Saturdays) until you successfully win a Jack Frost Doll.

quests.title: Fuse Jack Frost with Dia
quests.requirement: Jack Frost that knows the skill Dia
quests.walkthrough: Fuse Pixie (which knows Dia) with Silky to create Jack Frost. Alternatively, use a Dia Skill Card directly on Jack Frost.

quests.title: Fuse Valkyrie with Tarukaja
quests.requirement: Valkyrie that knows the skill Tarukaja
quests.walkthrough: Fuse Forneus (inherits Tarukaja) with Yomotsu-Shikome. During the fusion process, select Tarukaja as an inherited skill for Valkyrie.

quests.title: Retrieve a Shadow Crystal
quests.walkthrough: Search the Arqa block of Tartarus. Break the orange glowing debris/crystals scattered on the floors. They drop Shadow Crystals randomly.

quests.title: Retrieve a triangular sword
quests.walkthrough: Go to Gekkoukan High School, visit the Laboratory classroom on the 2nd floor, and search the shelves to find the triangular sword.

quests.title: Retrieve Pine Resin
quests.walkthrough: Speak to the Archery Club member in the school gym hallway during after-school hours to receive the Pine Resin.

quests.title: Retrieve Handheld Game System
quests.walkthrough: Talk to Junpei Iori in the dormitory lounge on 5/14 or later. He will give you his spare handheld game console.

quests.title: Fuse Oberon (Lv 17+)
quests.walkthrough: Fuse Jack Frost with Alp, or Nekomata with Lilim. Ensure your Emperor Social Link (Hidetoshi) is Rank 3+ so Oberon gets enough bonus EXP to level up instantly.

quests.title: Retrieve a Sengoku Helmet
quests.walkthrough: Go to Gekkoukan High School, visit the Faculty Office during after-school hours, and speak to Mr. Ono to obtain the helmet.

quests.title: Retrieve food fit for a gourmet
quests.walkthrough: Search normal chests in the first or second block of Tartarus. Odd Morsels are very common drops in standard chests.

quests.title: Fuse Mithras (Lv 22+)
quests.walkthrough: Fuse Valkyrie with Archangel, or Gurr with Inugami. Level him up in Tartarus or ensure your Chariot Social Link (Kazushi) is Rank 4+ for instant level up.

quests.title: Fuse Orthrus with Dodge Slash
quests.walkthrough: Fuse Valkyrie (who knows Dodge Slash) with Queen Medb, or Rakshasa (who knows Dodge Slash) with Yaksini. Inherit Dodge Slash during the fusion.

quests.title: Rank 1: Ippon-Datara with Sukukaja
quests.walkthrough: Fuse Sylph (Temperance) with Archangel (Justice). Sylph learns Sukukaja at level 12, so level Sylph up first, then perform the fusion.

quests.title: Rank 2: Matador with Mahama
quests.walkthrough: Fuse Anzu (Hierophant) with Berith (Hanged Man). Anzu learns Mahama at level 19, so level Anzu up first, then inherit it during fusion.

quests.title: Rank 3: Gdon with Beast Weaver
quests.walkthrough: Fuse Ares (Chariot) with Shiisaa (Hierophant). Ares knows Beast Weaver from the start; simply inherit the skill during the fusion.

quests.title: Rank 4: Neko Shogun with Bufula
quests.walkthrough: Special cross-fusion of Ara Mitama + Kusi Mitama + Saki Mitama + Nigi Mitama. First, fuse King Frost (has Bufula) with Hua Po to get Kusi Mitama, inheriting Bufula. Then complete the cross-fusion.

quests.title: Rank 5: Black Frost with Auto-Sukukaja
quests.walkthrough: Special pentagram fusion: Jack Frost + Pyro Jack + King Frost + Pixie + Ghoul. First, fuse High Pixie (who learns Auto-Sukukaja at level 23) with Ghoul to get Jack Frost, inheriting Auto-Sukukaja. Then perform the pentagram fusion.

quests.title: Rank 6: Yatagarasu with Megido
quests.walkthrough: Fuse Taotie (who has Megido naturally) with Cu Chulainn to get Yatagarasu. Make sure to inherit Megido.

quests.title: Rank 7: Yatsufusa with Mediarahan
quests.walkthrough: Special pentagram fusion: Thoth + Orthrus + Makami + Mot + Neko Shogun. First, fuse Alraune (who has Mediarahan naturally) with Triglav to get Mot, inheriting Mediarahan. Then complete the fusion.

quests.title: Rank 8: Ganesha with Tetrakarn
quests.walkthrough: Fuse Decarabia (who learns Tetrakarn at level 50) with Cu Chulainn to get Ganesha. Inherit Tetrakarn.

quests.title: Rank 9: Trumpeter with Mind Charge
quests.walkthrough: Special hexagram fusion: Taowu + White Rider + Red Rider + Black Rider + Pale Rider + Trumpeter. First, level Taowu to level 38 to learn Mind Charge, then complete the fusion, inheriting Mind Charge.

quests.title: Quest 1: I Wish to Befriend My Classmate
quests.requirement: Find the girl at the school lobby who wants to talk to a classmate.
quests.walkthrough: Speak to the girl in Gekkoukan's school lobby, then talk to her classmate in the classroom, and report back.

quests.title: Quest 2: I Wish I Had My Snacks
quests.requirement: Feed a hungry child at the Shinto Shrine.
quests.walkthrough: Talk to the boy at the shrine. Buy round sweets from the shopping district and give them to him.

quests.title: Quest 3: I Wish I Had a Hobby
quests.requirement: Help the man who wants a new hobby.
quests.walkthrough: Talk to the man in Yasoinaba shopping district, buy him a model kit from the hobby shop, and help him build it.

quests.title: Quest 4: I Wish I Could Speak English
quests.requirement: Help the student who is failing English.
quests.walkthrough: Meet the student at Yasoinaba, obtain the English study book from the school library, and tutor them.

quests.title: Quest 5: I Wish My Dog Would Return
quests.walkthrough: Look for the dog near Yasoinaba flood plains. Feed it Beef Bowl or other food items daily until it trusts you and returns home.

quests.title: Quest 6: I Wish I Had a Boyfriend
quests.walkthrough: Talk to the girl at the shopping district, find a suitable match at the high school, and set them up.

quests.title: Quest 7: I Wish I Could Find a Real Job
quests.requirement: Help the unemployed man find work.
quests.walkthrough: Find job flyers in the town bulletin board, recommend a job at the daycare or pub, and check on his progress.

quests.title: Quest 8: I Wish for World Peace
quests.requirement: Help the shrine visitors find peace of mind.
quests.walkthrough: Talk to the elderly woman at the shrine, clean up the shrine grounds, and pray with her.

quests.title: Rank 1: Jack Frost with Mabufu
quests.reward: Strength Social Link Rank 1, Unlocks Group Guillotine
quests.walkthrough: Fuse Berith (Hierophant) with Silky (Priestess). Alternatively, level Jack Frost to level 12 to learn Mabufu naturally.

quests.title: Rank 2: Shiisaa with Frei
quests.walkthrough: Fuse Jack-o'-Lantern (Magician) with Makami (Temperance). Makami knows Frei, inherit it.

quests.title: Rank 3: Matador with Magaru
quests.walkthrough: Fuse Nekomata (Magician) with Obariyon (Fool). Nekomata knows Magaru, inherit it.

quests.title: Rank 4: Flauros with Tarukaja
quests.walkthrough: Advanced Guillotine fusion: Berith + Andras + Eligor. Eligor has Tarukaja naturally, inherit it.

quests.title: Rank 5: Ame-no-Uzume with Dodge Psy
quests.reward: Strength Social Link Rank 5, Unlocks Guillotine Booster
quests.walkthrough: Fuse Kin-Ki (Chariot) with Sui-Ki (Chariot). Sui-Ki learns Dodge Psy at level 27, level him up and inherit the skill.

quests.title: Rank 6: Neko Shogun with Dekaja
quests.walkthrough: Advanced Guillotine fusion: Kodama + Sudama + Anzu. First fuse Orobas (knows Dekaja) with Kodama to get Sudama with Dekaja. Then complete the fusion.

quests.title: Rank 7: Lachesis with Tetraja
quests.walkthrough: Fuse Koppu Tengu (who knows Tetraja) with Pixie to make Clotho with Tetraja. Then fuse Clotho with Regent or Stone of Scone to get Lachesis.

quests.title: Rank 8: Hecatoncheires with Masukukaja
quests.walkthrough: Fuse Lilim (Devil) with Anzu (Hierophant). Lilim learns Masukukaja at level 34, level her up first and inherit it.

quests.title: Rank 9: Bugs with Samarearm
quests.walkthrough: Advanced Guillotine fusion: Pixie + Pisaca + Hariti. Hariti learns Samarearm at level 41. Level Hariti up first and inherit it.

quests.title: Rank 10: Seth with High Counter
quests.reward: Strength Social Link Rank 10, Unlocks Special Treatment
quests.walkthrough: Advanced Guillotine fusion: Isis + Anubis + Thoth + Horus. You can obtain a High Counter Skill Card from request 'The Killer Who Cleans Up' on 10/14, or fuse Dakini (learns it at level 52) with Pale Rider to get Horus, inheriting High Counter.
